Sandbox_EscapeFromZomboidFirearms_Viewpo: Live: rounds fly with the mod's ballistics; a server with ZombieBuddy and EscapeFromZomboidFirearmsServer flies them, otherwise the shooter's client flies it and the server checks each hit (PZ's anti-cheat does not check it). Shadow: log only. Off: PZ's own shots. A server switches Shadow to Live once.
Sandbox_EscapeFromZomboidFirearms_Firear: Reach of this mod's firearms in PZ's own shot path (isometric without the mod's ballistics, or a server without them). With the mod's ballistics a round keeps its own range.
Sandbox_EscapeFromZomboidFirearms_AllFir: All firearms range without mod ballistics (x)
Reach of every other firearm (vanilla and other mods) in PZ's own shot path, weapons already found too. Melee weapons do not change.
Sandbox_EscapeFromZomboidFirearms_Injury: Arm injuries, pain, fatigue, thirst and encumbrance affect weapon handling while first-person recoil is on. Character stats do not change. Default: On.
Sandbox_EscapeFromZomboidFirearms_HandGr: Smoke clouds block sight, zombies' sight too. The smoke is drawn either way. Default: On.
Sandbox_EscapeFromZomboidFirearms_Viewpo: Debug servers only: logs shots and the skeletons nearby for tests. Does not change the ballistics. Default: Off.
Sandbox_EscapeFromZomboidFirearms_PactLo: Loot everywhere except the places of state forces. Left NATO, right Warsaw Pact; a step moves 5 of 100 weapons, -5 is NATO 75 / Warsaw Pact 25. New loot only.
Sandbox_EscapeFromZomboidFirearms_PactSt: NATO / Warsaw Pact: loot at state forces' places
Police, SWAT, prisons, security posts, military places and vehicles. Left NATO, right Warsaw Pact; a step moves 5 of 100 weapons, -9 is NATO 95 / Warsaw Pact 5. New loot only.
NATO / Warsaw Pact: state forces' zombies and A-Life NPCs
State forces' zombies (police, army, guards) and A-Life police and military. Left NATO, right Warsaw Pact; a step moves 5 of 100 weapons, -9 is NATO 95 / Warsaw Pact 5. New loot only.
Sandbox_EscapeFromZomboidFirearms_PactPe: NATO / Warsaw Pact: other zombies and A-Life NPCs
All other zombies, and A-Life civilians and raiders. Left NATO, right Warsaw Pact; a step moves 5 of 100 weapons, -5 is NATO 75 / Warsaw Pact 25. New loot only.

Do not spawn (replaced by EFZ loot)
